import importlib.util, json, random, sys
def load(n,p):
    s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(n,p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
mn=load("m","/work/submission/main.py"); rf=load("r","/work/tmp/dev/ref.py"); g=load("g","/work/tmp/dev/gen4.py")
def deep(o): return json.loads(json.dumps(o))
bad=0; stats={}
for i in range(4000):
    rng=random.Random(77000+i); doc=g.gen(rng)
    a=mn.run(deep(doc)); b=rf.run(deep(doc))
    s=a["summary"]; m=a["metrics"]
    stats[s["coverage_status"]]=stats.get(s["coverage_status"],0)+1
    for k,cond in (("amb",s["ambiguous_observed_classes"]),("uniq",s["unique_observed_classes"]),
                   ("dedup",m["deduplicated_ping"]),("cap",m["capacity_drops"]),
                   ("late",m["late_ping"]),("ign",m["ignored_ack"]),("paths4",s["topology_paths"]>3)):
        if cond: stats[k]=stats.get(k,0)+1
    if a!=b:
        bad+=1; print("MISMATCH seed",77000+i)
        for k in ("rounds","metrics","classes","summary"):
            if a[k]!=b[k]: print(" ",k,"main",json.dumps(a[k])[:800],"\n     ref ",json.dumps(b[k])[:800])
        json.dump(doc,open("/work/tmp/dev/fail4_%d.json"%(77000+i),"w"),indent=1)
        if bad>2: break
print("failures",bad,stats)
